30225-many-gods.title: Many Gods
30225-many-gods.creator: Unknown
30225-many-gods.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The wind that blew from Cassiopeia cast Wanly upon my ear a rune that rung; The sailor in his eyrie on the mast Sang an "All's well," that to the spirit clung Like a lost voice from some aërial realm Where ships sail on forever to no shore, Where Time gives Immortality the helm, And fades like a far phantom from life's door.

arxiv-2005-03352.title: Pricing under a multinomial logit model with non linear network effects.
arxiv-2005-03352.creator: Felipe Maldonado, Gerardo Berbeglia, Pascal Van Hentenryck
arxiv-2005-03352.description: Abstract . We study the problem of pricing under a Multinomial Logit model where we incorporate network effects over the consumer’s decisions. We analyse both cases, when sellers compete or collaborate. In particular, we pay special attention to the overall expected revenue and how the behaviour of the no purchase option is affected under variations of a network effect parameter.

arxiv-2112-15471.title: A Survey on Using Gaze Behaviour for Natural Language Processing
arxiv-2112-15471.creator: Sandeep Mathias, Diptesh Kanojia, Abhijit Mishra, Pushpak Bhattacharyya
arxiv-2112-15471.description: Abstract Gaze behaviour has been used as a way to gather cognitive information for a number of years. In this paper, we discuss the use of gaze behaviour in solving different tasks in natural language processing (NLP). The collection of gaze behaviour is a costly task, both in terms of time and money.

arxiv-2201-04153.title: Designing non-Hermitian real spectra through electrostatics
arxiv-2201-04153.creator: Russell Yang, Jun Wei Tan, Tommy Tai, Jin Ming Koh, Linhu Li, Stefano Longhi, Ching Hua Lee
arxiv-2201-04153.description: Abstract Non-hermiticity presents a vast newly opened territory that harbors new physics and applications such as lasing and sensing. However, only non-Hermitian systems with real eigenenergies are stable, and great efforts have been devoted in designing them through enforcing parity-time (PT) symmetry.

arxiv-2206-11242.title: Structural and Dynamical Analysis of the Quiescent Molecular Ridge in the Large Magellanic Cloud Pipeline-CASA51-P2-B v.40896 ( Davis 2021 ) , CASA ( McMullin et al. 2007 , v.5.1.1-5, v.5.6.1; ) , astrodendro ( Rosolowsky et al. 2008 ) , quickclump ( Sidorin 2017 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration
arxiv-2206-11242.creator: Molly K. Finn, Remy Indebetouw, Kelsey E. Johnson, Allison H. Costa, C.-H. Rosie Chen, Akiko Kawamura, Toshikazu Onishi, Jürgen Ott, Marta Sewiło, Kazuki Tokuda, Tony Wong, Sarolta Zahorecz

Rosie Chen, Akiko Kawamura, Toshikazu Onishi, Jürgen Ott, Marta Sewiło, Kazuki Tokuda, Tony Wong, Sarolta Zahorecz. We present a comparison of low-J 13 CO and CS observations of four different regions in the LMC—the quiescent Molecular Ridge, 30 Doradus, N159, and N113, all at a resolution of ∼ 3 \sim 3 pc.

arxiv-2206-14933.title: Environment-assisted modulation of heat flux in a bio-inspired system based on collision model
arxiv-2206-14933.creator: Ali Pedram, Barış Çakmak, Özgür E. Müstecaplıoğlu
arxiv-2206-14933.description: Abstract The high energy transfer efficiency of photosynthetic complexes has been a topic of research across many disciplines. Several attempts have been made in order to explain this energy transfer enhancement in terms of quantum mechanical resources such as energetic and vibration coherence and constructive effects of environmental noise.

arxiv-2305-18957.title: Wave to Syntax: Probing spoken language models for syntax
arxiv-2305-18957.creator: Gaofei Shen 1 , Afra Alishahi 1 , Arianna Bisazza 2 , Grzegorz Chrupała 1
arxiv-2305-18957.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gaofei Shen 1 , Afra Alishahi 1 , Arianna Bisazza 2 , Grzegorz Chrupała 1. Understanding which information is encoded in deep models of spoken and written language has been the focus of much research in recent years, as it is crucial for debugging and improving these architectures. Most previous work has focused on probing for speaker characteristics, acoustic and phonological information in models of spoken language, and for syntactic information in models of written language.

arxiv-2411-10184.title: Agentic LLMs in the Supply Chain: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Consensus-Seeking
arxiv-2411-10184.creator: Valeria Jannelli a,b , Stefan Schöpf b,c , Matthias Bickel a , Torbjørn Netland a , and Alexandra Brintrup b,c
arxiv-2411-10184.description: Abstract This paper explores how Large Language Models (LLMs) can automate consensus-seeking in supply chain management (SCM), where frequent decisions on problems such as inventory levels and delivery times require coordination among companies. Traditional SCM relies on human consensus in decision-making to avoid emergent problems like the bullwhip effect.

arxiv-2507-08084.title: Reverberation Mapping Data of NGC 5548 Imply a Multicomponent Broad-Line Region Journal: ApJ Julia, BroadLineRegions.jl
arxiv-2507-08084.creator: Kirk Long, Jason Dexter
arxiv-2507-08084.description: Abstract Line broadening and variability are observational hallmarks of active galactic nuclei which allow us to measure supermassive black hole masses as well as constrain the geometry and kinematics of the emitting gas, with the most precise measurements requiring a degree of modeling.

arxiv-2507-13426.title: Second-degree Price Discrimination: Theoretical Analysis, Experiment Design, and Empirical Estimation
arxiv-2507-13426.creator: Soheil Ghili, K. Sudhir, Nitish Jain, Ankur Garg
arxiv-2507-13426.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Soheil Ghili, K. Sudhir, Nitish Jain, Ankur Garg. We build on theoretical results from the mechanism design literature to analyze empirical models of second-degree price discrimination (2PD). We show that for a random-coefficient discrete choice (“BLP”) model to be suitable for studying 2PD, it must capture the covariance between two key random effects: (i) the “baseline” willingness to pay (affecting all product versions), and (ii) the perceived differentiation between versions.

arxiv-2512-00657.title: Computational Paths Form a Weak ω \omega -Groupoid
arxiv-2512-00657.creator: Arthur F. Ramos, Tiago M. L. de Veras, Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz, Anjolina G. de Oliveira
arxiv-2512-00657.description: Abstract . Lumsdaine (2010) and van den Berg-Garner (2011) proved that types in Martin-Löf type theory carry the structure of weak omega-groupoids. Their proofs, while foundational, rely on abstract properties of the identity type without providing explicit computational content for coherence witnesses.

arxiv-2512-01045.title: Med-CRAFT: Automated Construction of Interpretable and Multi-Hop Video Workloads via Knowledge Graph Traversal
arxiv-2512-01045.creator: Shenxi Liu, Kan Li, Mingyang Zhao, Yuhang Tian, Shoujun Zhou, Bin Li
arxiv-2512-01045.description: Abstract . The scarcity of high-quality, logically annotated video datasets remains a primary bottleneck in advancing Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for the medical domain. Traditional manual annotation is prohibitively expensive and non-scalable, while existing synthetic methods often suffer from stochastic hallucinations and a lack of logical interpretability.

pmc-10754033.creator: Elisa Ortiz-Rivero, Sergio Orozco-Barrera, Hirak Chatterjee, Carlos D González-Gómez, Carlos Caro, María-Luisa García-Martín, Patricia Haro González, Raúl A Rica, Francisco Gámez
pmc-10754033.description: Anisotropic hybrid nanostructures stand out as promising therapeutic agents in photothermal conversion-based treatments. Accordingly, understanding local heat generation mediated by light-to-heat conversion of absorbing multicomponent nanoparticles at the single-particle level has forthwith become a subject of broad and current interest.

pmc-11302545.title: Who is (not) vaccinated? A proposal for a comprehensive immunization information system
pmc-11302545.creator: Giacomo Pietro Vigezzi, Elena Maggioni, Fabrizio Bert, Corrado de Vito, Roberta Siliquini, Anna Odone
pmc-11302545.description: The role of immunization in public health is crucial, offering widespread protection against infectious diseases and underpinning societal well-being. However, achieving optimal vaccination coverage is impeded by vaccine hesitancy, a significant challenge that necessitates comprehensive strategies to understand and mitigate its effects.

pmc-11332883.title: Entrepreneur's social identity, decision logic, and resource bootstrapping behaviors: An empirical study of the fsQCA method
pmc-11332883.creator: Yue Ling Liu, Xue Bing Peng, Meng Ting Wang, Lu Lu Chen
pmc-11332883.description: While resource bootstrapping is widely employed by novice entrepreneurs,and social identities and decision logic are studied as important antecedents of entrepreneurs' adoption of resource bootstrapping behaviors, both scholars and practitioners have but a hazy understanding on the configuration effect of entrepreneur's social identities and decision logic on resource bootstrapping behaviors.

pmc-12593847.title: Comparison of Computed Tomography Findings of Tuberculosis and Non-Tuberculous Mycobacterial Lung Infections
pmc-12593847.creator: Ayla Turkar, Aylin Babalik
pmc-12593847.description: BackgroundThe treatment of non-tuberculous mycobacterial infections, which are becoming increasingly common, is different and longer than tuberculosis. Correct diagnosis and subtyping are vital for patient management.PurposeTo determine the radiological findings of mycobacterial infections, detect differences, and contribute to the most accurate and rapid diagnosis.

pmc-12665245.title: Paradigm Shift in Global Governance of Medical Brain-Computer Interface: Addressing Practical Challenges Through Institutional Innovation
pmc-12665245.creator: Rongrong Zhu, Yangyang Zhao, Yetong Li
pmc-12665245.description: The rapid advancement of medical brain-computer interface (BCI) technology necessitates the transformation and upgrading of traditional governance paradigms urgently. China, the United States, and the European Union hold prominent positions in the global medical BCI landscape and have developed three highly representative governance models.

pmc-13313974.title: Improvement in coat condition observed in dogs with suspected alopecia X through combined supplementation with nutrients for the coat and skin: A case report
pmc-13313974.creator: Atsuhiro Murayama, Kentarou Tahara, Eiichi Hirano
pmc-13313974.description: Background:Alopecia X is characterized by non-inflammatory hair loss and is commonly observed in dogs with double coats and dense undercoats. The exact cause of alopecia X remains unknown, and its complex etiology and diverse responses to treatment make it challenging for veterinarians to manage.Case Description:An 8-year-old Chihuahua (male, unneutered, weight 4.1 kg) with significant hair loss presented to our clinic.

pmc-13393048.title: Continuous Monophasic Production of Pharmaceutical-Grade 5‑Hydroxymethylfurfural from Sugar Syrup
pmc-13393048.creator: Nattee Akkarawatkhoosith, Kritsanalak Thongkan, Attasak Jaree, Tiprawee Tongtummachat
pmc-13393048.description: A continuous-flow, monophasic catalytic process for the direct production of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (5-HMF) from sugarcane syrup was developed using a microreactor platform to enable sustainable, pharmaceutical-compatible manufacturing. In contrast to conventional mineral-acid or biphasic systems, green citric acid was employed as a sustainable catalytic alternative. Low-toxicity solventsdeionized water, acetone, n-propanol, and isopropanolwere systematically evaluated to balance reaction performance and downstream compatibility.

pmc-13422805.creator: Yue Yu, Jie Zheng, Jianqing She, Zuyi Yuan, Yue Wu

pmc-13434666.title: BCL2 inhibition in acute and chronic pancreatitis — is there a therapeutic perspective?
pmc-13434666.creator: Jacek J Litewka, Monika A Jakubowska, Wei Huang, Pawel E Ferdek
pmc-13434666.description: Necrotic death of pancreatic acinar cells leads to premature activation of digestive enzymes and is a central driver of inflammation in acute pancreatitis (AP). In contrast, apoptosis is a non-lytic, regulated form of cell death that prevents the release of intracellular content and is therefore considered less damaging.

pmc-13587915.title: Ultrasound-assisted extraction of polyphenols from Moutan Cortex using natural deep eutectic solvent: Optimization, molecular mechanisms, and lipid-lowering activity
pmc-13587915.creator: Shaojie Yin, Weilong Peng, Yongjuan Wang, Hui Lu, Peng Liu, Xinchi Zhu, Haifeng Yang, Jingui Li, Liuhui Li
pmc-13587915.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Graphical abstractKeywords: MoutanCortex, Ultrasound-assisted extraction, Natural deep eutectic solvents, Polyphenols, COSMO-RS, Molecular dynamics simulation, Lipid-lowering activity

Introduction

Moutan Cortex, the root bark of Paeonia suffruticosa Andrews, has been used clinically in China for nearly 2000 years [1]. Peony is native to parts of Asia, Europe, and North America and is widely cultivated in East Asia, especially in China and Japan, where it is valued both as an ornamental plant and as a medicinal resource [2].

pmc-13633405.title: Successful Delayed Elective Separation of Pygopagus Conjoined Twins With Shared Spinal Cord and Dura in a Resource‐Limited Setting: A Case Report
pmc-13633405.creator: Z. U. M. Wahid, Saiful Islam Chowdhury, Nushrat Islam, Sumaya Khan Mifty
pmc-13633405.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Conjoined twins are a rare consequence of aberrant monozygotic twinning; one of the varieties is pygopagus twins, which are fused at the sacral region and may involve complex neural and dural sharing. We report a case of female pygopagus conjoined twins with shared spinal cord and dural sharing who underwent successful delayed elective separation at 6 months of age in a resource‐limited tertiary care setting. Initial imaging revealed sacral deficiency, dural fusion, and spinal cord involvement without bony fusion.

pmc-13647608.title: Mental health interventions for carers of individuals with eating disorders: a systematic review of randomized controlled trials assessing efficacy on anxiety and depressive symptoms
pmc-13647608.creator: Ilaria Riboldi, Chiara Alessandra Capogrosso, Cristina Crocamo, Alessandro Chinello, Luigi Enrico Zappa, Francesco Bartoli, Giuseppe Carrà
pmc-13647608.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCarers of individuals with eating disorders (EDs) often experience high levels of psychological distress, which can lead to anxiety and depressive symptoms. While several interventions have been developed to support carers, the effectiveness on their mental health remains unclear.MethodsWe performed a systematic review of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) assessing mental health interventions for carers of individuals with EDs, with anxiety and depressive symptoms defined as outcomes of interest.
